metadata.title: Data Density Pass 19 -- Day 2 Afternoon Gap Coverage (Ticks 330-375)
metadata.description: Brigade-level coverage for the ticks 330-375 period currently thin in the data -- after Cemetery Hill assault repulse, before the overnight consolidation. Covers: Rodes's division pulling back on Oak Ridge, Anderson's division reforming after Wright's repulse, XII Corps returning to Culp's Hill, Confederate consolidation on Seminary Ridge, Union II Corps night dispositions.
